title: 1962 AHSME Problem 35
statement: A man on his way to dinner shortly after \(6{:}00\) p.m. observes that the hands of his watch form an angle of \(110^\circ.\) Returning before \(7{:}00\) p.m. he notices that again the hands of his watch form an angle of \(110^\circ.\) The number of minutes that he has been away is:

solutions.text:
The two observations lie on opposite sides of the instant when the hands coincide. Their signed angular separation changes by \(220^\circ.\) Since the minute hand gains on the hour hand at \(6-0.5=5.5^\circ\) per minute, the elapsed time is \[ \frac{220}{5.5}=40 \] minutes.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: During the interval, the minute hand gains on the hour hand at \(5.5^\circ\) per minute
Between the two observations, the signed separation changes from \(110^\circ\) to \(-110^\circ\)
